name: the-construct
description: The Construct: martial-arts skills for Claude Code. Install one and Claude knows kung fu.

plugins.name: operator
plugins.description: Your operator on the other side: Morpheus flavor lines and the "Uploading <art>.skill" banner whenever a martial art is loaded.

plugins.name: kung-fu
plugins.description: I know kung fu. Root-cause debugging kata: reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, fix, verify.

plugins.name: aikido
plugins.description: Redirect, don't resist. Defuse hostile review feedback and immovable constraints with the smallest redirecting change.

plugins.name: jiu-jitsu
plugins.description: Position before submission. Pin legacy behavior with characterization tests, then refactor.

plugins.name: wing-chun
plugins.description: Own the centerline. Cut code to the shortest path: YAGNI, fewer abstractions, less indirection.

plugins.name: krav-maga
plugins.description: No rules, only threats. Fast, pragmatic security sweep of a diff.

plugins.name: tai-chi
plugins.description: Stillness in the storm. Calm incident response: stabilize, communicate, diagnose, fix, learn.

plugins.name: muay-thai
plugins.description: The art of eight limbs. Eight-angle code review of a diff or PR.

plugins.name: drunken-boxing
plugins.description: Unpredictable by design. Generate chaotic edge cases and fuzz inputs that break code before users do.

plugins.name: judo
plugins.description: Maximum efficiency, minimum effort. Reuse what exists before writing anything new.

plugins.name: kendo
plugins.description: One precise cut. Surgical, single-purpose edits with no collateral changes.
